mk0_golden_dataset.role: Structural and technique evidence foundation. MK0 golden fixtures are not relabeled as MK1 behavioral test cases.

mappings.note: The F4 rewrite cases test behavior such as missing input, ambiguity and fact preservation. Those cases are new MK1 tests; the MK0 fixture contributes structural/technique evidence only.
The MK0 exemplar is cross-domain review evidence, not a software-review test. MK1 authors software-specific behavioral fixtures and preserves the provenance boundary.

mk0_fixture_refs.title: Tu Rescate Financiero: plan de 90 días para ordenar tu dinero

mappings.note: MK0 contributes separate evidence-requirement and comparison exemplars. MK1 composes those learned patterns into technical-decision behavior and tests new contradictory/unverified/noise cases.

policy.direct_lineage: Use per-case mk0_fixture_ids only when a behavioral case is actually derived from a specific MK0 fixture. Empty direct-lineage arrays are valid and must not be filled cosmetically.
policy.cross_stage_derivation: Every F4 fixture set must have a mapping to existing MK0 evidence or an explicit documented reason why no MK0 evidence applies.
policy.copyright_boundary: The bridge references MK0 fixture metadata/fingerprints and techniques; it does not reproduce source prompt bodies.
policy.evidence_boundary: MK0 evidence can justify architecture/pattern selection. It cannot by itself prove MK1 behavioral success.
